accepted_findings.finding: Native n8n errorWorkflow dispatch did not fire for isolated real webhook failures despite the configured handler ID.
accepted_findings.mitigation: The active five-minute execution monitor is the certified failure path. It polls only the governed production allowlist, reads metadata-only error indexes, deduplicates by execution ID, persists the reliability record and sends sanitized Slack alerts.

accepted_findings.finding: The full-instance backup orchestrator can exceed the connector/manual execution boundary.
accepted_findings.mitigation: Tayoca uses the existing bounded sanitized backup worker directly for the governed production set; all six governed snapshots passed the inactive restore drill.
